tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Rows, panels, the ribbon.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover row, selected row, open session header.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and lanes.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus-adjacent edges (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta columns, units, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Lane labels and timestamps on bg and surface; 4.5:1 floor.

tokens.name: ch-model
tokens.usage: Channel: model calls (/v1/messages). Marks, swatch, model column.

tokens.name: ch-analytics
tokens.usage: Channel: product analytics. The chatty one; density bars and its counter.

tokens.name: ch-flags
tokens.usage: Channel: feature flags and experiments.

tokens.name: ch-skills
tokens.usage: Channel: reach — MCP servers, skills, tools.

tokens.name: ch-count
tokens.usage: Channel: tokens and token counting.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live dot and the live chip. Nothing else.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive command marker and coverage gap. Always with ▲ and a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid; 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: agent-claude-code
tokens.usage: Agent identity: Claude Code. Agent chip dot, session-band edge. Same hue as ch-skills by design: it is Claude Code's reach.

tokens.name: agent-codex
tokens.usage: Agent identity: Codex (reserved).

tokens.name: agent-chatgpt
tokens.usage: Agent identity: ChatGPT web (reserved).

tokens.name: agent-claude-ai
tokens.usage: Agent identity: claude.ai (reserved).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks while loading or waiting.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every row: sessions, prompts, steps, requests.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Repo names, tool names, counts that lead a row.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sentences: coverage check, About this data, empty states.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding (dense); chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, panels, ribbon tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Preview gutter; section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions (header, capabilities, sessions).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rows, lanes, ribbon cells: the grid is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, bars, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Live dot only.
